item.title: ChordShot 1.3.0
item.description:
ChordShot 1.3.0 — initial public beta
Screenshots with a two-button mouse drag or a configurable trackpad shortcut. Press Space while selecting for silent MP4 recording, with a countdown, red recording indicator, and Stop control. PNG saving and clipboard output, an optional login item, and signed in-app updates.
Requires macOS 15.2 or newer. Includes Apple silicon and Intel executables; Intel hardware testing is still pending. Initial beta: additional real-world mouse, trackpad, multi-display, recording, and first-install testing is needed. Earlier development builds may need one final permission approval when moving to this production signing identity.
